# Quirk

> Your LinkedIn, your quirk - AI-powered LinkedIn content generation from trending topics.

**Type:** MERN-stack SaaS Web Application  
**Repository:** https://github.com/Sooraj-Suresh-Dev/quirk  
**License:** MIT

Quirk is an AI-powered content generation platform that scrapes trending topics from GitHub Trending, Product Hunt, and Hacker News — then generates personalized LinkedIn posts (text, carousel frameworks, image prompts) using AI. Users can train a personal brand voice by pasting sample posts.

**Technology Stack**

*Frontend (`packages/web`)*: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui components, React Router v6, React Helmet Async, Lucide React icons, clsx, Vitest + React Testing Library

*Backend (`packages/server`)*: Express.js + TypeScript, MongoDB + Mongoose ODM, JWT authentication + magic links (Supabase), OpenRouter (Llama 3.1 70B default, OpenAI GPT-4o/mini, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Mixtral, Gemma), Google Gemini for image prompts, Node-cron for scheduled jobs, Resend for email delivery, Zod for validation

*Monorepo*: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo

**Key Pages & Routes**

*Public Pages*: `/` (Landing page with hero, features, trend preview, CTA), `/auth/magic-link` (Magic link authentication flow), `/auth/set-password` (Password setup via magic token), `/trends` (Public trend browsing), `/features` (Feature overview), `/pricing` (Pricing page), `/about` (About page), `/faq` (FAQ page), `/terms` (Terms of service), `/privacy` (Privacy policy)

*Authenticated Pages*: `/dashboard` (Main dashboard with trends + generation + history), `/discover` (Full trend feed with source filters), `/voice-training` (Voice training interface with 3-5 sample posts), `/settings` (User preferences for sources, digest time, notifications, AI keys), `/library` (Generated post history management), `/generate/:trendId` (Post generation interface)

**API Endpoints**

Base URL: `/api` (frontend proxies via Vite to `localhost:3001/api`)

*Authentication*: `POST /api/auth/magic-link` (Send magic link email, public), `POST /api/auth/set-password` (Set password via magic token, public), `POST /api/auth/login` (Email + password login, public), `GET /api/auth/session` (Get current session, auth required), `POST /api/auth/refresh` (Refresh access token, auth required), `POST /api/auth/logout` (Sign out, auth required)

*Trends (Public)*: `GET /api/trends` (List cached trends with source filter, pagination, search), `GET /api/trends/:id` (Get single trend), `POST /api/trends/refresh` (Force-refresh trends, auth required)

*Posts (Auth Required)*: `GET /api/posts` (List user's generated posts with pagination, weekly/total counts), `GET /api/posts/models` (List available AI providers/models), `POST /api/posts/generate` (Generate new post: text, carousel, image-prompt), `PATCH /api/posts/:id` (Update post status: generated/copied/posted), `DELETE /api/posts/:id` (Delete post)

*User Profile (Auth Required)*: `GET /api/users/profile` (Get user profile + voice profile), `GET /api/users/voice` (Get saved voice profile), `POST /api/users/voice/analyze` (Analyze samples only, preview not saved), `POST /api/users/voice/extract-url` (Extract post text from LinkedIn URL), `POST /api/users/voice` (Save analyzed voice profile), `PATCH /api/users/voice/toggle` (Toggle voice active/inactive), `DELETE /api/users/voice` (Delete voice profile), `PUT /api/users/preferences` (Update preferences: sources, digest time, email toggle, AI keys, provider/model/temperature), `POST /api/users/verify-key` (Verify OpenAI/Anthropic API key)

*Health*: `GET /api/health` (Health check, public)

**Data Models**

*User*:
```typescript
{
  email: string (unique, lowercase, trim)
  passwordHash?: string
  refreshToken?: string
  preferences: {
    sources: string[]              // default: ['github', 'producthunt']
    digestTime: string             // default: "10:00"
    emailDigest: boolean           // default: true
    openaiKey?: string
    anthropicKey?: string
    preferredProvider?: string     // 'openai' | 'anthropic' | 'openrouter'
    preferredModel?: string
    preferredTemperature?: number
  }
  createdAt: Date
}
```

*Voice*:
```typescript
{
  userId: ObjectId (unique, indexed)
  samples: string[]                // 3-5 samples, max 2000 chars each
  profile: {
    tone: {
      primary: string
      secondary: string[]
      confidence: number
    }
    writingStyle: {
      description: string
      avgSentenceLength: number
      avgParagraphLength: number
    }
    personality: {
      traits: string[]
      description: string
    }
    structure: {
      description: string
      pattern: string[]
    }
    engagement: {
      cta: 'None' | 'Soft' | 'Direct'
      questions: 'None' | 'Rare' | 'Occasional' | 'Frequent'
      emoji: 'None' | 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High'
      emojiFrequency: number
    }
    signaturePatterns: string[]
    contentPatterns?: {
      topics: string[]
      audienceType: string
    }
    generation?: {
      formality: 'Formal' | 'Professional' | 'Casual'
      energy: 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High'
      firstPersonUsage: 'Minimal' | 'Moderate' | 'Frequent'
      sentenceComplexity: 'Simple' | 'Medium' | 'Complex'
      vocabulary: 'Simple' | 'Simple-Technical Mix' | 'Technical' | 'Advanced'
      evidenceUsage: 'None' | 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High'
      opinionStrength: 'Neutral' | 'Moderate' | 'Strong'
    }
    brandSummary: string
    trainingQuality: {
      score: number
      consistency: string          // 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low'
      limitations: string[]
    }
  }
  isActive: boolean
  createdAt: Date
  updatedAt: Date
}
```

*Trend*:
```typescript
{
  source: 'github' | 'producthunt' | 'hackernews'
  title: string
  url: string
  summary: string
  tags: string[]
  thumbnailUrl?: string
  stars?: number
  forks?: number
  votes?: number
  points?: number
  comments?: number
  website?: string
  makers?: string[]
  author?: string
  createdAt?: string
  fetchedAt: Date
  expiresAt: Date                 // TTL index: 7 days (604800 seconds)
}
```

*Post*:
```typescript
{
  userId: ObjectId (indexed)
  trendId?: ObjectId
  content: string | Record<string, unknown>[]  // text | carousel slides | image prompt
  type: 'text' | 'carousel' | 'image-prompt'
  status: 'generated' | 'copied' | 'posted'
  createdAt: Date
}
```

**Key Features**

1. **Trend Discovery** — Hourly scraping from GitHub Trending, Product Hunt, Hacker News with 7-day MongoDB cache (TTL index) and quality filtering/deduplication
2. **AI Post Generation** — Three post types: text (hook+body+CTA), carousel (multi-slide structure), image prompts (Gemini-ready); supports OpenRouter (Llama 3.1 70B default), OpenAI, Anthropic
3. **Personal Voice Training** — Paste 3-5 sample posts (or extract from LinkedIn URLs) → AI analyzes tone, writing style, personality, structure, engagement patterns, generation preferences → saves comprehensive profile → applies to all generations
4. **Daily Digest** — Configurable morning email with 3 text posts + 1 carousel + 1 image prompt via Resend
5. **Post Management** — History with pagination, copy-to-clipboard, regenerate, mark as posted, delete, weekly/total stats
6. **Magic Link Auth** — Passwordless authentication via email with JWT access/refresh tokens in httpOnly cookies

**Getting Started**

*Prerequisites*: Node.js >= 18, pnpm (`npm i -g pnpm`), MongoDB (local or Atlas)

*Install*:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Sooraj-Suresh-Dev/quirk.git
cd quirk
pnpm install
```

*Configure*:
```bash
cp .env.example packages/server/.env
```
Required env vars: `MONGODB_URI`, `JWT_SECRET`, `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`
Optional: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `EMAIL_FROM`, `PRODUCT_HUNT_API_TOKEN`, `VITE_API_URL`, `VITE_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID`

*Run Development*:
```bash
pnpm dev            # both web + server
pnpm dev:web        # frontend only → localhost:5173
pnpm dev:server     # backend only → localhost:3001
```

*Build*:
```bash
pnpm build
```
